data.name: Hyundai Accent Long-Term Hire
data.description: Long-term Hyundai Accent hire across Melbourne. A tidy, economical small car for commuting, city driving and everyday errands.

mainEntity.name: How much does the Hyundai Accent cost to hire?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Hyundai Accent is $180 per week including GST, with 1,400 km included each week and a $500 bond.
Yes. The Accent is a light small car that is economical for everyday driving.
Yes, the Accent is an automatic and seats 5 including the driver.

mainEntity.name: Is it good as a long-term everyday car?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It is a reliable, easy everyday car on flexible weekly and monthly terms, with no long lock-in contract.
